title: Unbounded K-flat preservation under arbitrary open extension
statement: Let j:U→X be any open immersion and A any commutative coefficient ring. For a cochain complex P of A-module sheaves on U-small-étale, if its canonical constant-module realization is K-flat in the independent-coefficient sense of [def-pc-kflat-complex], then the realization of the degreewise exact extension by zero j-shriek P is K-flat on X-small-étale. Use exactly etaleKFlat and the degreewise extension of [lem-coef-etale-open-comparison-data]. No quasi-compactness or boundedness assumption is made.

source.place: Parent proof step 5: extension by zero preserves K-flat complexes by the unbounded total-tensor projection formula

proof.text: An open immersion is étale by [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-etale]. Let E_U and E_X be the canonical constant-module realization equivalences of [lem-pur-etale-sum-tensor-test]. Equivalences preserve and reflect exact short complexes and hence degreewise acyclicity. Lift an arbitrary acyclic ringed-site test B on X along the degreewise equivalence E_X to a module-valued complex K. The lift is acyclic. Exact inverse image makes j-star K acyclic.

The natural two-variable tensor comparison of [lem-pur-etale-constant-module-tensor] induces an isomorphism on unbounded direct-sum total complexes: the realization equivalence preserves coproducts and its additive comparison respects both differentials. K-flatness of P applied to E_U(j-star K) therefore implies acyclicity of Tot((j-star K) tensor P). Reflection of acyclicity along E_U is used here.

Apply exact j-shriek. The unbounded total-tensor comparison [lem-coef-etale-open-total-tensor], extracted from the canonical construction without a quasi-compactness hypothesis, identifies Tot((j-shriek P) tensor K) with j-shriek Tot(P tensor j-star K). On both sides use total-complex symmetry, whose (p,q) component is (-1)^(pq) times the sheaf tensor symmetry, to obtain acyclicity of Tot(K tensor j-shriek P). Apply E_X and its total tensor comparison, and replace E_X K by the original test B along the equivalence counit. This is the required acyclic test, for every B.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleOpenKFlat
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) ℤ)
    (hP : etaleKFlat U A P) : etaleKFlat X A
      (((j)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A].mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
